nodes.label: Vendored ShadowHook Prebuilt Import
nodes.rationale: shadowhook is linked from a vendored prebuilt copy rather than through prefab because prefab outputs live in Gradle's artifact-transform cache and were unusable on the build host, making :app:buildCMakeDebug fail intermittently.

nodes.norm_label: 16 kb max page size linker flag

nodes.label: SAMP_LTO (ThinLTO)
nodes.rationale: ThinLTO produces a smaller/faster .so but is much slower and heavier to link, so it defaults OFF because building inside Termux/proot can run out of RAM.

nodes.label: SAMP_OPTIMIZE (-O3 Always)
nodes.rationale: The NDK toolchain adds -O0 for Debug after CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS, so -O3 in CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS was ignored in assembleDebug builds and native code ran unoptimised; the stack protector is dropped because it costs a canary check on every function with a local array on hot render/network paths.

nodes.label: Recursive Source Glob (CONFIGURE_DEPENDS)
nodes.rationale: One recursive glob replaces ten hand-written depth patterns while keeping the same file set, and CONFIGURE_DEPENDS re-globs when files are added or removed.
